message.content: In the conversation between EmilyBurnett and LiHua, EmilyBurnett mentions that she appreciates the series' focus on character development and backstory, which allows viewers to form emotional connections with the characters. Specifically, during their discussion about "The Rings of Power," EmilyBurnett highlights how the series emphasizes character development and reveals emotional layers in the story, stating, "The visuals are amazing, right? I really love how they are bringing Middle-earth to life. My favorite part so far has been the emphasis on character development and their backstories. It feels like we’re really getting to know them!" This indicates that EmilyBurnett finds the series particularly compelling because of its ability to delve deeply into the characters' backgrounds and personalities, making them feel more personally invested in their journeys.
